description: Search Koskamo datasets for candidate passages with source citations and document versions. Similarity scores rank matches and do not measure factual confidence.

dataset.description: Optional dataset id or slug. Defaults to all public datasets.

name: koskamo_retrieve

assessment.description: Candidate availability only; does not assess whether the question is answered

degraded.description: Present only when a backend was unavailable and passages came from a keyword fallback; coverage may be partial

guidance.description: What returned passages and scores do and do not establish

chunkId.description: Chunk uuid for database-backed datasets; dataset:document:ordinal for the bundled catalog

datasetVersion.description: Collection version at retrieval time; documentVersion identifies the exact document

documentVersion.description: Document content version; increments when an approved revision replaces the document

ordinal.description: Chunk position inside the source document

score.description: Ranking score within the retrieval engine; not a confidence probability

version.description: Alias of datasetVersion kept for existing citers

title: Retrieve cited passages
